doc.title: Harry Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997

title: Mouthpieces and chasing sound
summary: Switches mouthpieces often to get the exact sound he wants.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: Are you a player that’s constantly looking for different sound, different horn, different mouthpiece and all that?

Different mouthpiece yeah. And sound is probably the most important thing for me for the saxophone. I seem to get very frustrated when I can’t get the exact sound I want and so I switch mouthpieces quite often. I have a nice collection.
